name: Question 16
problem: The rate, in degrees Farhenheit per month, at which the average midday temperature in New York City varies, does so according to the function $R(t)={t}^{3}+3,$ where $t$ is the number of months since the measurements began. Estimate the total increase in air temperature over the first three months using the trapezoidal rule with $3$ trapezoids of equal height.
